newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND SQUEEZE PAST PUMAS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND SQUEEZE PAST PUMAS.

text.p: A debut international try with eight minutes left from hooker Mark Regan saved England from a huge Twickenham embarrassment on Saturday as they edged to a 20- 18 win over Argentina.
The Pumas were deservedly leading 18-15 until England finally mounted a concerted forward challenge on their opponents' line and Regan claimed the score.
It robbed Argentina of a historic first win at Twickenham which would have ranked amongst the biggest upsets in international rugby all year.
Six penalties from fly-half Gonzalo Quesada was almost enough to do the trick, but opposite number Mike Catt kept his lacklustre side in the game with five of his own.
